summary: After labelling the node, add the label to the container group's custom pod spec in automation controller, for example a nodeSelector of aap_node_type: execution with namespace ansible-automation-platform, serviceAccountName default, and an ansible-runner worker container requesting 250m CPU and 100Mi.
questions: How do I add a nodeSelector to a container group pod spec?
Example container group pod spec with nodeSelector
How do I restrict container group jobs to labelled nodes?

answer_card.title: Container group pod spec with a nodeSelector
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  namespace: ansible-automation-platform
spec:
  serviceAccountName: default
  automountServiceAccountToken: false
  nodeSelector:
    aap_node_type: execution
  containers:
    - image: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-22/ee-supported-rhel8@sha256:...
      name: worker
      args: [ansible-runner, worker, '--private-data-dir=/runner']
      resources:
        requests:
          cpu: 250m
          memory: 100Mi
```

Label the nodes first, for example `kubectl label nodes <node> aap_node_type=execution`.
